commands.name: /INDEX
commands.purpose: CLI commands for SDDRA system in Claude AI.
commands.rules:
[CMD1] All commands MUST have a single-line description.
  [CMD2] Commands MUST NOT modify files unless mode is READ_WRITE.
  [CMD3] Commands with side effects MUST require human approval.
  [CMD4] Command output MUST be human-readable by default.
  [CMD5] Commands MUST support --help for usage information.
  [CMD6] StatefulExecution: EVERY command MUST run under the stateful
         flow — DISCOVER -> ANALYZE -> LOCATE CURRENT STEP -> EXECUTE ONLY
         CURRENT STEP -> VERIFY -> SAVE STATE -> STOP. A command that
         would execute a future step early is a FLOW VIOLATION (BLOCKED
         with reason). Project files + saved state are the source of
         truth — conversation history is NOT. (Phase 151)
  [CMD7] InitialLoad: every command auto-loads ONLY its declared
          InitialLoad manifest + INDEX routing; deeper content is
          EXPAND-only (bax ../context/cache.sdd PullBasedLoading).
          Bulk .sdd/ load is FORBIDDEN. (Phase 151)
  [CMD8] ThreeWayRegistry: every command is registered in ALL THREE
          locations — .sdd/commands/<name>.sdd (spec),
          .claude/commands/<name>.md (Claude Code wrapper),
          .kilo/command/<name>.md (Kilo wrap

commands.name: /sdd-evolve
commands.purpose:
Evolve the SDD knowledge/skill ecosystem: research current practices,
  compare against existing skills, validate, deduplicate, and deliver
  changes safely. (Git-state sync stays /sdd-update; UPDATE != GIT PULL.)

Owns: commands/sdd-evolve.sdd
commands.rules:
[EVO-01] /sdd-evolve NEVER replaces a skill directly — every change
           starts as a SKILL_EVOLUTION record (evidence-backed).
  [EVO-02] Source hierarchy L0>L1>L2>L3>L4>L5 governs confidence;
           L5-only (AI inference) changes are proposals, never updates.
  [EVO-03] Skills past review_after are re-researched; fresh skills
           are skipped (unless --deep).
  [EVO-04] Deduplication runs before creation: canonical is chosen,
           duplicates become aliases/references/deprecated — [SK13]
           granularity, [R81] link over copy.
  [EVO-05] Delivery respects trust mode: TRUST_0..TRUST_5 map to
           Phase 131 authority levels; direct push requires L4-style
           human approval for irreversible registry changes.
  [EVO-06] Update Manifest (UPD-<n>) is mandatory for every run —
           machine-readable audit trail ([R95] references it).
  [EVO-07] NO_VALUE research outcome -> DISCARD (research does not
           obligate skill creation) — recorded in research record.
  [EVO-08] Routing files touched by evolution stay human-authored
           ([R109]); evolution PROPOSES routing edits, never rewrites.

  SDDRA execution trace, plus today's work, history context, and
  phase/layer position.

commands.rules:
